FeatureJson.description: A feature moved by the release.

kept.description: The other targets its spec names, left as they were.

FileJson.description: A source file the release rewrites.

file.description: The file, from the project root.

added.description: The files it gains, by their path in the output.

build.description:
The build: `site`, or an older line's, `site@3.4`. Empty for the
file the lines share.

output.description:
The output: `site`, `plain`, or `json`, or `_ascribe` for the file
the lines share.

RedirectJson.description: An address and where it should go, as the headers list writes a path.

from.description: The address, from the site's root.

to.description:
Where it should go: a path from the site's root, or the archive's
full address.

UnusedJson.description: Content no line has, or a mark that says nothing.

file.description: The file, from the project root.

kind.description:
`page`, `section`, `block`, `row`, or `mark`, for a mark that says
nothing and can go while its content stays.

text.description:
Its first line: a page's title, a section's heading, a block's or a
row's first line, or the mark.

description:
What `ascribe versions retire --format json` writes: the line, its
address, the marks rewritten, what no line has any more, and where each
of the line's addresses should go.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

ended.description:
The day the line's support ended: its `ends`, or the day it was
retired.

features.description: Each feature whose spec is rewritten.

files.description: Each source file whose marks are rewritten, from the project root.

outputs.description:
The outputs of builds that aren't lines of the target that the
rewrite changes, by build and output: they need `--force`, and a dry
run lists them.

redirects.description:
Where each address the line published should go, by address: the
same page in the current line, the page that replaces it there, or
its page in the archive.

removed.description: Whether what `unused` lists was deleted, with `--remove-unused`.

retired.description:
Whether this run retired the line: false when it was archived
already, and the run only listed or removed what it left.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

unused.description:
What no live or planned line has, and the marks that say nothing
once rewritten, by file and line.

url.description: Where the line's archive is read.

written.description: Whether the files were written: false with `--dry-run`.

title: VersionsRetireReport
